input.prompt:
Create a SIMPLE CLEAN 16:9 GAME-LEVEL TOPOLOGY DIAGRAM on a plain pale background. This is NOT final art. No buildings, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers.

Draw one dark gray road graph only:
LEFT ENTRY -> short shared road -> very obvious Y SPLIT -> TWO SEPARATE branches -> very obvious Y MERGE -> short shared road -> RIGHT EXIT.

The upper branch curves upward and across the top-middle.
The lower branch curves downward and across the bottom-middle.
There must be a LARGE empty gap between upper and lower branches through the middle.
The two branches must not touch or cross until the single merge near the right side.
Do not make a loop. Do not make one snake/S-road. Do not add any extra road.

Add exactly 12 simple build-pad circles OFF the road:
3 before the split,
3 beside upper branch,
3 beside lower branch,
3 around merge/final segment.
Pads should be plain teal circles with dark outlines.
Everything else blank. Clean vector-like diagram, crisp top-down layout, no perspective.
